name: Little Nightmares: Enhanced Edition - Secrets of The Maw Expansion Pass
summary:
Can't get enough of Little Nightmares?

Unveil all the secrets of the Maw in a parallel escape story where you play as the Runaway Kid, another prisoner looking for a way out of this place of misfortune. On his journey, The Kid will explore the Depths, the Hideaway and the Residence, offering a different perspective on Six’s adventures as well as new challenges to overcome.

The Enhanced Edition offers higher resolution, improved visual effects, and is optimized for higher framerates. Additional helpers have been added to deliver an overall smoother experience.

Save data is not compatible with the original 2017 game: Little Nightmares.
